{"metadata":{"description":"The next-gen lightweight coding agent cli","id":"gh:1180401969","install_available":false,"language":"Python","name":"KimiX","slug":"Sikao-Engine/KimiX","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"The next-gen lightweight coding agent cli"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Kimi-CLI-X"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> 中文文档"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"`install.py` handles the whole setup: dependency sync, native runtime download, and tool registratio"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"nstall.py` handles the whole setup: dependency sync, native runtime download, and tool registration."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> **Note:** This repo supports not only KIMI LLM but also various API keys! Like OpenAI, Anthropic, "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"etc. Default config templates are in `docs/`; use `kimix --config=xx.json` after setup."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Why Kimi-CLI-X?"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Kimi-CLI-X is a deep optimization of the original Kimi-CLI, focusing on **prompt efficiency**, **too"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"l reliability**, and **extensibility**, plus new tools for real-world development."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Optimizations"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"1. **Lean system prompts** — Compressed initial prompts and tool descriptions down to ~2000 tokens w"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"hile covering nearly all built-in tools.
2. **Hardened permissions & validation** — Properly handles"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" Shell, Glob, and other tool validations to reduce retry loops from failures.
3. **Better subprocess"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" output** — Redirects large outputs to temp files and filters redundant logs for easier backend retr"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"ieval.
4. **Simpler concurrency** — Streamlined design for subprocesses, sub-agents, and background "},{"id":"p11s6","text":"tasks.
5. **Programmable prompts** — Allows custom system prompt injection at the upper layer for fl"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"exible scenarios.
6. **Explicit conversation management** — Clearer multi-task orchestration and sta"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"te tracking.
7. **Write-and-validate** — Auto format checks and warnings on strict config files to p"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"revent model-hallucinated errors.
8. **Multi-API support** — Import custom configs compatible with O"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"penAI, Anthropic, and more.
9. **Verified backends** — Tested against kimi, xai, anthropic, openai_l"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"egacy, openai_responses, google_genai/gemini, vertexai/vertex, plus 25+ Hermes-ported providers (dee"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"pseek, openrouter, xiaomi, zai, minimax, bedrock, ...). See `kimi-cli/tests/core/test_create_llm.py`"},{"id":"p11s13","text":" and the Supported Providers list."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### New Capabilities"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Capability | Description |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| **Interactive shell tools** | Start and continue `Bash`/`Powershell`/`Run` sessions via `task_id`,"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" with optional `wait_for_pattern`. |
| **Docx / PDF conversion** | Built-in document conversion with"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"out external deps. |
| **Python script execution** | Agent can run Python scripts directly. |
| **Er"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ror logging** | Records tool-call errors for model backtracking and improvement. |
| **Script system"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"** | Combines prompts with Python logic to orchestrate complex tasks. |
| **Enhanced web fetch (fetc"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"h_url)** | Headless-browser-based Markdown output (not plain text), supports `output_path` and auto-"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"truncation for超长 content; zero external service dependency. |
| **Best-of-N sampling (`AgentSwarm` `"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"parallel_sample`)** | Run the SAME task N times in isolated workspaces (git worktree / temp copy), p"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"ick the winner via `self_eval` or `majority` selection, then apply and verify the winning diff — nev"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"er a silent accept. |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Scriptable Workflows (Core Advantage)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Unlike traditional CLI interaction where you type commands one by one, **Kimi-CLI-X lets you write P"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ython scripts to orchestrate entire workflows**. You can combine prompts, loops, conditionals, and t"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ool calls into fully automated, reproducible task pipelines:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Benefits:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Batch automation**: Use native Python syntax (`for` loops, file globbing) to fire tasks at multi"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ple files at once.
- **Complex orchestration**: Freely compose mode switches, tool calls, and logic "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"into multi-stage, multi-branch workflows.
- **Reproducible & maintainable**: Workflows live as versi"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"on-controlled scripts, not ephemeral chat history."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Context Memory Architecture"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Kimi-CLI-X embeds an **automatic context memory system** inside the `KimiSoul` core loop, keeping lo"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ng conversations coherent without manual intervention. Three layers work together:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"#### 1. Conversation History Index (HistoryIndex)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Every user/assistant message is automatically indexed by **BM25 inverted index** (N-gram, n=2) on ap"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"pend, persisted to `<session>/history_index/<id>.json`, and survives process restarts. Cap at 500 ro"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"unds; oldest evicted automatically."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"#### 2. Automatic Context Compaction (SimpleCompaction)"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Triggered when context token ratio hits `compaction_trigger_ratio` or free space falls below `reserv"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ntext token ratio hits `compaction_trigger_ratio` or free space falls below `reserved_context_size`:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **Retention policy**: Recent N rounds kept verbatim (depth adapted by `adaptive_preserve_depth` — "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"deepened on errors, thinking, multi-file edits, etc.); first message always kept (primacy effect).
-"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" **LLM summarization**: Old messages compressed into structured summaries via a lightweight LLM call"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"; thinking blocks discarded.
- **Cascade handling**: When already-compacted content is compressed ag"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"ain (depth ≥3), switches to `COMPACT_CASCADE` prompt to prevent information degradation.
- Post-comp"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"action, all rounds marked `is_compacted` in HistoryIndex for future retrieval."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Agent Harness: Self-Regulation & Reminders"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The `KimiSoul` core loop actively keeps long runs on track — no manual babysitting. It works in CLI,"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" server, and sub-agent sessions alike."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Verification Gate** — a turn can't end while todos are unfinished, or while files were edited wi"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"thout running any check. Failing checks are fed back to the agent to fix.
- **Anti-loop detection** "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"— catches repeated edits to the same file across different tools, and the same error recurring witho"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"ut a root-cause fix; nudges the agent to change strategy.
- **Todo reminders** — unfinished todos ar"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"e periodically re-surfaced at the end of the context, so goals never drift out of attention.
- **Bud"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"get reminders** (opt-in) — wrap-up warnings as the per-turn step/time budget runs out, so the agent "},{"id":"p29s7","text":"finishes gracefully instead of being cut off.
- **Decision-aware compaction** — compaction summaries"},{"id":"p29s8","text":" preserve a `Decisions & Conclusions` and a `Verification Status` section, so early decisions and ve"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"rified work survive.
- **Context pruning** — stale tool outputs, thinking blocks, and near-duplicate"},{"id":"p29s10","text":" content are automatically elided to reclaim context space."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### todo_list
The `todo_list` tool tracks multi-step plans — one tool, one item shape:
- Read (omit "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"`todos`), upsert (`mode='merge'`, default), whole-tree write (`mode='replace'`), `mode='clear'`, wit"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"h per-todo notes.
- Nested sub-todos via `parent=`/`scope=`; `complete=true` finishes a subtree in o"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"ne call, `rename_to` renames in place.
